messages.content: Help me extract all data entries with the attribute 'data-active' set to true from a list element stored in a variable named 'listElement'?

function.name: getActiveDataEntries
function.description: This function extracts data entries from a list element based on a specified attribute and its value. It checks for the presence of the 'data-active' attribute and whether it is set to true. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

listElement.description: The list element from which to extract active data entries. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

attribute.description: The data attribute used to filter entries. Optional parameter with a default value of 'data-active'. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

value.description: The value of the attribute to match. Optional parameter with a default value of true. This is JavaScript Boolean type parameter in string representation.

message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick example of how you’d call the `getActiveDataEntries` helper to pull out only those items whose `data-active` flag is set to `true`.

```js
// Assuming you already have your list element in a variable called `listElement`
const activeItems = getActiveDataEntries({
  listElement: JSON.stringify(listElement),   // Pass the element as a JSON‑string
  attribute: 'data-active',                  // (Optional – defaults to this)
  value: true                                // (Optional – defaults to true)
});

console.log(activeItems);   // → array of objects where data-active === true
```

**What happens under the hood**

* `JSON.stringify(listElement)` turns whatever JavaScript object/array you’re working with into a plain string so the helper can parse it.
* The helper then scans each entry, looks for the `data-active` attribute, and returns only those entries where that attribute equals `true`.

If you run this in your environment, `activeItems` will contain just the “active” entries from your original list.
